Description: FIPS stands for Federal Information Processing Standards. FIPS codes are numbers that uniquely identify geographic areas.  The number of digits in FIPS codes varies depending on the level of geography. County-level FIPS codes have five digits, of which the first two are the FIPS code of the state to which the county belongs.
Geographic Area Name
The year in which is the data is from
The geographic level on which the data exists.
Note:
1 = US
2 = State
3.1 = County
3.2 = County Subdivision
4 = Tract
5 = Blog Group
